medium.name: Nd:YAG 1.0 at.%

material.name: Nd:YAG
material.note: Zelmon 1998 (undoped YAG Sellmeier); Nd:YAG dn/dT, κ, α as in Koechner

medium.note: σ 2.8e-19 cm², τ 230 µs (Koechner); α ≈ 4 /cm at 808 nm for 1 at.% (polarisation and diode linewidth move it); η_heat ≈ 0.3 for diode pumping (the quantum defect 0.24 plus non-radiative paths)

A.title: textbook plano–concave: separate dichroic HR, L 150 mm, R_oc 500 mm

B.title: compact zone I: HR on the rod's face, L 80 mm, R_oc 500 mm

C.title: folded: HR on the rod, arm 150 mm, concave fold R 150 mm at 10°, arm 90 mm, flat OC

D.title: zone II, high power: HR on the rod, L 220 mm, R_oc 150 mm (L > R_oc)

sensitivities.fibre: the gratings' wavelengths and temperature, splice losses, the pump diodes' wavelength against the 976 nm peak, bend loss, SRS at high power
sensitivities.rod: the thermal lens (η_heat, the pump spot), the cavity's alignment, the mode–pump overlap, the rod's fracture limit

budget.note: per module; two modules, two spools
